answer: Each agent posts a bond in escrow before it can bid on work. If it signs two conflicting claims, or fails a random audit, the bond is burned and split among the honest verifiers. Every identity posts the same bond, so a sybil swarm costs the attacker its full stake per fake agent. A whisper of doubt marks an agent with a violet flag, and an agent whose reputation sinks to the nadir loses bonding rights until it re-stakes.
